sources.title: Odisha Tourism · Cuisine and Culinary Trails
sources.note: The Coastal & Seafood Trails section names Baleshwar among coastal dining destinations and lists fish, prawns and crabs. It describes a regional food setting, not a particular kitchen’s menu.

sources.title: Jitu Mishra · The tale of Chandipur beach beyond the vanishing sea (10 October 2019)
sources.note: Mishra’s dated travelogue describes the Budhabalanga estuary and fish landings at Balaramgadi. It is an account from 2019, not a current auction schedule or evidence of a restaurant’s supply.
